description: Assemblyman Ed Ra (R-Franklin Square) will host a ceremony at Mineola High School today at 4:30 p.m. where he will honor the 30 semi-finalists and announce the winner of his 2026 “There Ought To Be A Law” contest. The annual contest invites students to think critically about public policy by proposing ideas they believe could make effective laws. This year, the contest received 553 submissions from students throughout the district. WHO: Assemblyman Ed Ra (R-Franklin Square)
title: RA TO ANNOUNCE WINNER OF EIGHTH ANNUAL ‘THERE OUGHT TO BE A LAW’ CONTEST
